name: cell03-parallel-shard-runner
title: Add a safe parallel shard runner for Cell 03 evidence rows
description: B-991d Cell 03 full execution is currently resumable but serial and appends to one row ledger. We need a small correctness story that adds deterministic shard planning, per-shard output, shard locking, and merge validation before any operator can safely parallelize the 1,152-row Cell 03 matrix.
